meta.title: Demonology equipment data

sources.label: Demonology Fandom Wiki - Equipment (canonical, authoritative for prices, unlock levels, carry quantities)
AllThings.How - All Demonology Equipment Explained (cross-check for carry quantities and functions)

meta.notes: Disputed unlock levels resolved against the canonical Demonology Fandom wiki: Defibrillator = Level 35, Rock Salt Shotgun = Level 40 (Fandom overrides AllThings.How's L40/L45). Photo Camera = Level 3 confirmed. Carry quantities filled from AllThings.How where the Fandom table cells collapsed; both sources agree where both list a value. Limited-Time confirmed complete: Fandom states only one limited-time item has ever released (the legacy Plushie). Prices and quantities are in-game comparison values, presented evergreen with no dates or freshness claims. Locked items can be skipped with the in-game 'Unlock Instantly' option for R$160 Robux each; loadout is capped at 3 carried items per job.

items.name: Blacklight
items.function: Shine it on surfaces to reveal fingerprints, handprints, and footprints left by the ghost.

items.name: EMF Reader
items.function: Tracks ghost activity from level 2 to 5. An EMF Level 5 reading counts as evidence.

items.name: Flashlight
items.function: A basic light source for navigating dark rooms. Gathers no evidence on its own.

items.name: Flower Pot
items.function: Its flowers wither near ghosts that leave Wither evidence, making it the main tool for confirming Wither.

items.name: Laser Projector
items.function: Placed in the ghost's favorite room, it can reveal the ghost's translucent silhouette.

items.name: Spirit Book
items.function: Left in the favorite room, the ghost may write in it to confirm Ghost Writing evidence.

items.name: Spirit Box
items.function: Used in the favorite room with the lights off, it lets the ghost respond to confirm Spirit Box evidence.

items.name: Thermometer
items.function: Shows room temperature so you can find the favorite room. A reading of 0C/32F or lower confirms Freezing Temperatures.

items.name: Video Camera
items.function: Detects Ghost Orbs when held or viewed through the base camp computer. Can be placed or carried.

items.name: Photo Camera
items.function: Takes up to six photos per job. You earn money based on the subjects you capture, such as ghosts or handprints.

items.name: Cross
items.function: Stops a hunt from starting within a 3-meter radius. Must sit in the favorite room and burns out after a successful use.

items.name: Lighter
items.function: Lights lanterns, candles, and a summoning circle, and gives off a small amount of light itself.

items.name: Lantern
items.function: A brighter light than the flashlight. When lit, it slows passive energy drain for you and nearby hunters. Needs a lighter to ignite.

items.name: Salt Canister
items.function: Lays salt lines on the floor to capture Handprint evidence as footprints when disturbed. Holds three lines per canister.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.function: Restores 50% of your energy when consumed.

items.name: Head-Mounted Camera
items.function: A hands-free camera teammates can watch from base camp, without taking up an inventory slot.

items.name: Holy Oil
items.function: Laid in a line on the ground, it ignites when a hunt begins and forms a barrier the ghost cannot cross.

items.name: Energy Watch
items.function: Lets you check your energy level without returning to base camp.

items.name: LIDAR Scanner
items.function: A mapping device that reveals the ghost's outline when scanned. Used to locate the ghost, not to gather evidence.

items.name: Plushie
items.function: Floats when a ghost interacts with it and responds to the Spirit Box for 15 seconds, helping gather or rule out Spirit Box evidence.

items.name: Defibrillator
items.function: Revives a dead hunter once.

items.name: Rock Salt Shotgun
items.function: Holds two shots. Fire at the ghost to end a hunt instantly, or at a teammate to ragdoll them.

items.name: Plushie (Legacy)
items.function: An earlier limited-time version of the Plushie. When a ghost interacts with it, it guarantees the Spirit Box evidence for 15 seconds.
